seo.title: Jackson House | Woodinville Restaurant & Craft Cocktail Bar
seo.description: Discover Jackson House in Woodinville, WA: seasonal dining, craft cocktails, weekly events, and memberships. Reserve your table today.

hero.title: Welcome to Jackson House
paragraphs: Jackson House is defining a new era of hospitality in Woodinville. Our focus is curated cocktails, artisanal local cuisine, and an experience where every plate, pour, and detail is crafted with intention.
Reserve your table on OpenTable. The finest in Woodinville awaits!

reviews.author: Dana S.
reviews.text: The food was some of the most unique and delicious food we’ve had in the area. The lamb chops, caesar salad, and mushrooms were our favorites, but everything was so good. Highly highly recommend!

reviews.author: Molly B.
reviews.text: We loved our time at Jackson House! We tried their limoncello and food offering at taste WA, and that is how we discovered this restaurant. I'm glad we did!

reviews.author: Corinne Z.
reviews.text: Incredible food, obviously, but the real treat is the bartender. Mixologist. Alchemist. Sorcerer. So creative and unique!!! I had an incredible dinner but I’ll be going back for some bites and sit at the bar.

reviews.author: Marcie S.
reviews.text: Came in here for date night with another couple and was very pleasantly surprised - I love finding amazing gems like this is my home town!

reviews.author: Tanner E.
reviews.text: Food, service and atmosphere were fantastic. I have been here twice now and both times I feel right at home.

reviews.author: Megan T.
reviews.text: The food is excellent. The vibe is very cute and moody in the best way, almost like a modern speakeasy, and the staff made my time very special.
